verdict.rationale: ObsessionDB documents full logging of every query an agent runs, with replay of exactly which columns it read. It also exposes the stock ClickHouse observability surface queryable cluster-wide, with drill-down to single executions. That covers a meaningful part of the audit-log half of the story, but the evidence shows no column-level lineage tracing where data originated. missing for 10: column-level data lineage (provenance of derived data), explicit user/identity attribution in audit logs for non-agent users, dedicated audit-log documentation, and independent corroboration.
